messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "use an injection on the same day each week"
set: ["use an injection on the same day each week", "taken about half an hour after the same meal each day", "take same way each day", "administer once weekly on the same day each week at any time of the day with or without meals", "take at around the same time each day", "taken at approximately the same time each day", "take at same time each day", "use new needle for each injection", "take with food at the same time each day", "same day", "take about 30 minutes after the same meal each day", "take on 3 to 5 days each week", "use different spot on abdomen each time", "can be taken any time of the day but take at the same time each day", "shake the bottle before each use", "start nicotine replacement product on the same day you quit smoking"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
